comparisons.name: notes-light
comparisons.description: One frame of the small spinner in Notes' sidebar, head at 9 o'clock, Aqua. No dark capture shows a spinner there.

comparisons.name: startup-disk-dark
comparisons.description: One frame of the small spinner in the Startup Disk pane, head at 3 o'clock, Dark Aqua. The light capture of the pane shows no spinner.

comparisons.name: bluetooth-light
comparisons.description: One frame of the small spinner in the header of the Bluetooth pane's device list, head at 12 o'clock, on a plain background, Aqua. The pane draws it at 15 pt on a half point, so at 1x, where a browser draws on whole pixels, about a sixth of the pixels differ; the 2x comparison gates the drawing.

comparisons.name: bluetooth-dark
comparisons.description: One frame of the small spinner in the header of the Bluetooth pane's device list, head at 3 o'clock, Dark Aqua. The 1x score is high for the reason given for bluetooth-light.
